findings.reason: a worker implementing only the named site fails the done-when's third case (a reflex-composed run review recording its origin), and the first two test cases are then indistinguishable, because the held request from §1 also carries `set_by: "dispatch"`; the site named must be the run-review branch at recovery_review_dispatch.py:2781-2865.
findings.text: s2 says "The lane a review follows is chosen by `_composed_review_lane`" and that recording the origin there reaches dispatch, but `dispatch_review_for_run` calls `_composed_review_lane` only when `record["subject"] == "plan"` (recovery_review_dispatch.py:2763, guarded at :2762); the reflex's run review (`recovery_watch.py:3622`, `prefer_local=True`) takes the `else` branch at :2781-2865 and gets its lane from `_review_lane_candidates(..., owning_backend=record["backend"])` at :2830, so recording provenance in `_composed_review_lane` sets nothing on the executed route and the review of a run still reaches `dispatch()` as `set_by: "dispatch"`, indistinguishable from a caller's `--backend`
